title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Environmental Pollution Crimes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Release of Typical Cases of Environmental Pollution Crimes

Case 1:

Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. Zijinshan Gold and Copper Mine — Major Environmental Pollution Accident Case

(1) Basic Facts

Since October 2006, there had been a serious leakage problem in the diversion culvert for clean and polluted water separation at the copper mine wet-process plant under the defendant unit, Zijinshan Gold and Copper Mine (hereinafter referred to as "Zijinshan Mine"). Although some measures were taken, the leakage problem in the culvert became increasingly serious as the scale of production expanded. In March 2008, without conducting investigation or feasibility studies, the Zijinshan Mine, in violation of regulations, arbitrarily connected Observation Well No. 6 with the flood discharge culvert. In September 2009, the Fujian Provincial Department of Environmental Protection explicitly identified the problem and required thorough rectification, but still insufficient attention was paid, and the corrective measures were inadequate and incomplete, leaving the hidden danger unresolved. In late June and the period around late June 2010, the precipitation in Shanghang County reached 349.7 mm. On July 3, 2010, the HDPE impermeable membrane of the wastewater pond at the copper mine wet-process plant of the Zijinshan Mine ruptured, causing copper-containing acidic wastewater to leak and flow into Observation Well No. 6, and then through the channel artificially connected to the flood discharge culvert into the flood discharge culvert, where it overflowed the retaining wall inside the culvert and entered the Tingjiang River. This resulted in a major environmental pollution accident involving the leakage of 9,176 cubic meters of copper-containing acidic wastewater, causing pollution of downstream waters and the mass death of farmed fish. The water supply from some tap water plants in the urban area of Shanghang County was suspended for one day. On July 16, 2010, another leakage occurred from the emergency No. 3 temporary transfer wastewater pond used for rescue operations, releasing 500 cubic meters of copper-containing acidic wastewater, further polluting the water quality of the Tingjiang River. This caused local waters of the Tingjiang River to be polluted by copper, zinc, iron, cadmium, lead, arsenic, etc., resulting in the death of up to 3.701 million jin of farmed fish, with the value of the fish loss appraised at RMB 22.206 million. Meanwhile, to ensure the safety of fish in net cages, local government departments took measures to break the nets, releasing 30.8444 million jin of fish.

(2) Judgment

The First Instance Judgment of the Xinluo District People's Court of Longyan City, Fujian Province, and the Second Instance Ruling of the Longyan Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant unit, Zijinshan Mine, violated state regulations by failing to take effective measures to eliminate existing environmental hazards, which led to the leakage of hazardous waste into the Tingjiang River, causing pollution to the water quality of the Tingjiang River and resulting in particularly serious consequences. The defendants, Chen Jiahong (served as the mine director of Zijinshan Mine from September 2006 to December 2009) and Huang Fucai (director of the Environmental Safety Department of Zijinshan Mine), were the persons directly in charge responsible for the accident. The defendants, Lin Wenxian (plant manager of the copper mine wet-process plant), Wang Yong (deputy plant manager in charge of environmental protection at the copper mine wet-process plant), and Liu Shengyuan (director of the environmental protection workshop of the copper mine wet-process plant), were the persons directly responsible for the accident. All of them bore direct responsibility for the accident, and their actions constituted the crime of major environmental pollution accident. In light of the defendant unit's voluntary surrender, active compensation for losses to the affected fishermen, and other circumstances, the court sentenced the defendant unit, Zijinshan Mine, to a fine of RMB 30 million for the crime of major environmental pollution accident; sentenced defendant Lin Wenxian to three years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 300,000; sentenced defendant Wang Yong to three years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 300,000; sentenced defendant Liu Shengyuan to three years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 300,000. Defendants Chen Jiahong and Huang Fucai were sentenced to probation.

Case 2:

Yunnan Chengjiang Jinye Industry and Trade Co., Ltd. — Major Environmental Pollution Accident Case

(1) Basic Facts

From 2005 to 2008, during its production and operation, Yunnan Chengjiang Jinye Industry and Trade Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Jinye Company") had long been directly discharging arsenic-containing production wastewater through open ditches and hidden pipes into a natural pond located on the lowest concave part of the plant area without anti-seepage treatment, and extracting the arsenic-containing wastewater from that pond for ore washing operations; it also dumped solid waste containing arsenic, namely phosphogypsum, into an open yard outside the plant area that lacked anti-seepage and anti-erosion measures for open-air storage; during periods of heavy rainfall, it directly pumped arsenic-containing wastewater from the natural pond into the phosphogypsum dump site northeast of the plant area adjacent to Yangzonghai Lake, allowing it to flow freely. This caused the arsenic-containing wastewater to enter Yangzonghai Lake through surface runoff and subsurface infiltration, resulting in arsenic pollution of the lake's water body, with water quality deteriorating from Class II to inferior Class V, loss of functions such as drinking water and aquatic product farming, interruption of water intake from county-level and above urban water sources, and particularly serious consequences including losses of over RMB 1 million to public and private property.

(2) Judgment

The First Instance Judgment of the Chengjiang County People's Court of Yunnan Province and the Second Instance Ruling of the Yuxi Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant unit, Jinye Company, failed to construct and improve supporting environmental protection facilities, and after multiple administrative penalties, still did not rectify the situation. This resulted in a large amount of arsenic-rich production wastewater from inside and outside the production area entering Yangzonghai Lake through subsurface infiltration via groundwater and surface runoff, causing this important lake to be polluted by arsenic, thereby constituting the crime of major environmental pollution accident, and it should be determined as having caused "particularly serious consequences." Defendant Li Dahong, as the chairman of Jinye Company, and defendant Li Yaohong, as the general manager (responsible for the overall work of the company) of Jinye Company, failed to take anti-seepage measures in accordance with regulatory requirements, ultimately leading to the harmful consequence of arsenic pollution of Yangzonghai Lake, and should bear corresponding criminal responsibility as the persons in charge of the unit's crime. Defendant Jin Dadong, as the production department head of Jinye Company, specifically responsible for safety production, environmental protection, and production scheduling, arranged for others to pump arsenic-containing wastewater outside the plant area, and should bear corresponding criminal responsibility as the directly responsible person for the unit's crime. After the incident, Jinye Company and the defendants actively cooperated with the relevant authorities in intercepting and treating the pollution, which could be considered as a mitigating factor for a lenient punishment. Accordingly, the court sentenced the defendant unit, Yunnan Chengjiang Jinye Industry and Trade Co., Ltd., to a fine of RMB 16 million for the crime of major environmental pollution accident; sentenced defendant Li Dahong to four years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 300,000; sentenced defendant Li Yaohong to three years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 150,000; sentenced defendant Jin Dadong to three years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 150,000.

Case 3:

Chongqing Yunguang Chemical Co., Ltd., et al. — Environmental Pollution Case

(1) Basic Facts

Chongqing Changfeng Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Changfeng Company") entrusted the defendant, Chongqing Yunguang Chemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Yunguang Company"), with the disposal of hazardous waste (secondary benzene series organic products) generated during its production process. Subsequently, defendant Jiang Yunchuan (legal representative of Yunguang Company) assigned the hazardous waste disposal work to the company's employee, defendant Xia Yong. Without verifying whether defendant Zhang Bibin possessed the capability to dispose of hazardous waste, Xia Yong directly transferred the hazardous waste entrusted by Changfeng Company to Zhang Bibin for disposal. Zhang Bibin then contacted defendants Hu Xuehui and Zhou Gang and, after an on-site inspection, decided to transport the hazardous waste to Huangshuituo in Gongsheng Town, Xingwen County, Sichuan Province for dumping. On June 12, 2011, Zhang Bibin arranged for a tanker truck to load over 28 tons of industrial wastewater from Changfeng Company, intending to transport it to Huangshuituo for dumping. However, because the vehicle was too large and the road too narrow to enter Huangshuituo, Zhou Gang, Hu Xuehui, Zhang Bibin, and others temporarily decided to dump the industrial wastewater on a barren slope beside the road at Da'aokou, causing serious environmental pollution in the local area. On June 14, 2011, Zhang Bibin loaded three truckloads of semi-solid hazardous waste in iron drums, approximately over 75 tons, from Changfeng Company and dumped them on a barren slope at the Zhenxing Pyrite Mine in Huangshuituo, causing serious environmental pollution in the local area and affecting the health of local residents and the production operations of enterprises. Appraisal determined that the disposal fees, on-site cleanup fees, transportation costs, etc., for the hazardous waste at Huangshuituo and Da'aokou amounted to RMB 918,315.

(2) Judgment

The Xingwen County People's Court of Sichuan Province held that: The defendant, Chongqing Yunguang Chemical Co., Ltd., as a professional enterprise for the disposal of chemical hazardous waste, violated state regulations on the disposal of chemical hazardous waste by handing over industrial sludge and industrial wastewater to defendant Zhang Bibin, who did not have the qualification to dispose of chemical hazardous waste, resulting in serious environmental pollution, thereby constituting the crime of environmental pollution. Defendant Zhang Bibin violated state regulations by dumping hazardous waste onto land, causing serious environmental pollution with serious consequences, thereby constituting the crime of environmental pollution. Defendants Zhou Gang and Hu Xuehui assisted defendant Zhang Bibin in committing the above acts, thereby constituting the crime of environmental pollution. Defendant Zhang Bibin voluntarily surrendered himself to the authorities, entitling him to a lighter or mitigated punishment according to law. Accordingly, the court sentenced the defendant, Chongqing Yunguang Chemical Co., Ltd., to a fine of RMB 500,000 for the crime of environmental pollution; sentenced defendant Xia Yong to two years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 20,000; sentenced defendant Zhang Bibin to one year and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 20,000. Defendants Jiang Yunchuan, Zhou Gang, and Hu Xuehui were sentenced to probation. After the judgment was pronounced, neither the defendant unit nor the individual defendants appealed, and the prosecutorial authority did not file a protest.

Case 4:

Hu Wenbiao, Ding Yuesheng — Crime of Throwing Hazardous Substances

(1) Basic Facts

Yancheng Biaoxin Chemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Biaoxin Chemical Company") was an enterprise designated by the environmental protection department as one that "shall not discharge wastewater." Defendant Hu Wenbiao was the legal representative of Biaoxin Chemical Company, previously convicted of the crime of falsely issuing special VAT invoices on June 27, 2005, and sentenced to two years' imprisonment with a three-year probation by the Yancheng Yandu District People's Court. Defendant Ding Yuesheng was the production manager of Biaoxin Chemical Company. From the end of November 2007 to February 16, 2009, defendants Hu Wenbiao and Ding Yuesheng, knowing that the wastewater generated during the company's production process contained toxic substances such as benzene and phenol, still discharged large amounts of wastewater into the Wuzhi River north of the company, allowing it to flow through the Mangshe River and pollute the water intake points of the Chengxi and Yuehe tap water plants in Yancheng urban area, causing the drinking water supply for over 200,000 residents of the Yancheng urban area to be suspended for 66 hours and 40 minutes, resulting in direct economic losses of RMB 5.4321 million.

(2) Judgment

The First Instance Judgment of the Yancheng Yandu District People's Court and the Second Instance Ruling of the Yancheng Intermediate People's Court held that: Hu Wenbiao and Ding Yuesheng, knowing that the wastewater generated during the company's production process contained toxic and hazardous substances, nonetheless directly or indirectly discharged large quantities of it into the river channels around the company, disregarding the occurrence of harm to the lives, health, and safety of public and private property of an unspecified number of persons, and causing significant losses to public and private property, thereby constituting the crime of throwing hazardous substances, and it was a joint crime. Hu Wenbiao played a principal role in the joint crime and was the principal offender; Ding Yuesheng played a secondary role in the joint crime and was an accessory. Hu Wenbiao committed a new crime during the probation period, so the probation should be revoked according to law and concurrent punishment for multiple crimes should be imposed. Accordingly, the court revoked the probation sentence for defendant Hu Wenbiao; defendant Hu Wenbiao was sentenced to ten years' imprisonment for the crime of throwing hazardous substances, to be merged with the punishment imposed for his previous crime, and the combined sentence was set at eleven years' imprisonment; defendant Ding Yuesheng was sentenced to six years' imprisonment for the crime of throwing hazardous substances.
